Reference image for the [[Jokes]] entry on [[Quick Draw]]: the United Artists poster for the 1967 United States release of ''A Fistful of Dollars'' (1964).

Source: [http://www.impawards.com/1967/fistful_of_dollars.html A Fistful of Dollars (1967)], IMP Awards (poster version 2). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20260512025836/http://www.impawards.com/1967/fistful_of_dollars.html Internet Archive], 12 May 2026.

License: Non-free. Fair-use rationale: a reduced copy (500 pixels wide) of the US release poster of ''A Fistful of Dollars'', the work the card's text refers to. It is used only to identify that work beside the card on [[Jokes]]. It cannot replace the original or harm its market, and no free image of it exists.
